messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — quick thread to align on the canary vs baseline drilldown in the rollout dashboard. I want: baseline overlay, per-slice breakdown, and a way to pin a slice for historical comparison. Thoughts?

Alex G: +1 on pinning. We should also surface sample size and relative confidence intervals next to metric deltas. Too many noisy alerts without N.

Ryan L: Agree. For latency we should show p50/p95/p99 bands, not just mean. Also correlate with traffic split — if canary is only 2% the p95 can be unstable.

Sasha K: UX question: pinning a slice — do we mean pin a label (e.g., "mobile-us-east"), or pin an arbitrary query filter? I prefer label + tag so it can be reused across rollouts.

Maya Chen: label/tag approach sounds good. We already annotate routes with policy tags (eg: routing:slow-path). Reuse that metadata.

Ken T: From infra side, metric joins for small slices can be expensive if we do realtime joins across every label. Proposal: precompute per-route aggregates for all rollout-relevant labels at 1m granularity and keep a 1h hot window for drilldowns. Cheaper than raw join on query time.

Nora: If we precompute, make sure the naming includes model_version + build_id. Otherwise rollout comparisons get ambiguous when baseline changes mid-rollout.

Alex G: Alerting: we should support relative delta alerts and absolute-threshold alerts. e.g. alert if canary latency p95 > baseline p95 * 1.15 AND sample_size >= 200. Example rule suggestion: `delta(p95, canary, baseline) > 0.15 && samples(canary) >= 200`.

Ryan L: Also add a traffic-aware noise suppression: if canary_traffic < 1% then mute delta alerts (or mark as advisory).

Sasha K: For the UI, show a small badge on the rollout timeline if an alert fired for the slice and clickable stack that opens the drilldown with the failing metric and the raw query.

Maya Chen: Good. Need one more API debate — do we return the precomputed aggregates via the existing /metrics endpoint or add /rollout_metrics with rollout-aware params? Backwards compat is a consideration.

Ken T: I'd add /rollout_metrics. We can keep /metrics stable. /rollout_metrics can accept `rollout_id`, `slice_tags[]`, `time_window`, and `granularity`. Easy to evolve.

Nora: +1 for separate endpoint. Also add `include_confidence=true` flag so clients don't have to calculate CIs. We can surface method used (bootstrap vs analytic).

Alex G: For alerts UI, allow exporting an alert as a JSON rule so infra can pin it to the release process. Small example in the thread:

```
{
  "name": "canary-p95-delta",
  "when": "rollout",
  "expr": "delta(p95, rollouts.canary, rollouts.baseline) > 0.15 and samples(rollouts.canary) >= 200",
  "mute_if": "rollouts.canary_traffic < 0.01"
}
```

Ken T: We'll need to map `delta()` to our backend function. I can add bindings in the query layer. Also we should store a precomputed baseline snapshot at rollout start to avoid baseline shifting.

Maya Chen: Snapshotting baseline at start is critical — otherwise a baseline drift mid-rollout can hide regressions. Add a checkbox in the console: "Freeze baseline at rollout start" default true.

ops-bot: Note: canary rollout 191234 started by @Maya Chen — traffic=5% — models: v12 -> v13.

Ryan L: Nice. Once devs snapshot baseline we should surface an easily shareable permalink to the exact baseline-snapshot + slice so SRE can reproduce.

Sasha K: UX nit: in the slice list, sort by impact score (delta * sample_weight) so most important ones bubble up. Impact score formula we can iterate on.

Nora: Also add a compact “explain” pane that shows correlated signals (errors, rate, CPU) when a metric regresses. Quick triage tool.

Maya Chen: Great notes — Ken and Alex, can you pair on the API + alert export work? Ryan and Sasha can prototype the UI pin and drill flow. I'll formalize requirements tomorrow and open an RFC. :thumbsup:

Alex G: Yep, i'll start a PR for /rollout_metrics schema.

Ken T: I'll wire the precompute pipeline and snapshot store. Will add schema doc to the RFC.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — this feels actionable. I'll post the RFC link here when ready.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: rollout-ui/feature/slice-pin -> staging (id: rui-2026-44).

Maya Chen: Awesome, thanks :party_parrot:
